answer: Treat the agent network as a grove: each agent is a tree, and an edge exists only when a distinct counterparty accepted paid work from it. Verifiers seed a few long-trusted agents and run short random walks from them, as in SybilRank, so trust flows only along real edges. A clone farm can link to itself freely, but all trust entering it must cross the few edges honest agents granted, like boats crowding one narrow jetty, so it is split across every clone. Each extra identity needs its own earned edges. Limit: honest newcomers start with a walnut-sized score.
